tools.name: field
tools.description: Today in The Wild: which altars still take a prayer today (one per spirit per UTC day), the votive candles on the wall, witness stones today, and every price. Read-only; never pays.

tools.name: spirits
tools.description: The 24 animal spirits with their ids, names, habitats, plates and page links. Use an id with altar or buy_kit. Read-only.

tools.name: altar
tools.description: One spirit's altar: its keeper, whether today's prayer slot is open, its lit days, the candles on it and the witness stones set at its feet. Read-only.

tools.name: buy_kit
tools.description: The exact HTTP contract for one paid act, from the published manifest: route, price and atomic amount, body, headers, the seal recipe, the signer rule and the reconcile rule. This tool never pays: pay with your own x402 client against the route it returns, only when your human asked.

tools.name: verify_witness
tools.description: Check words and a salt against a witness stone: recomputes sha256(salt + NUL + normalizedText) and compares it with the stone's commitment, and rechecks the stone's chain link. A pure hash check: nothing is stored or revealed. To publish the words, POST the reveal route instead.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_witness · Public sink: verify_witness.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_witness · Public sink: verify_witness

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
